entries.text: As per 於# (fill gaps) + 疒 illness → *hematoma* (← pile-like localized swelling filled with extravasated blood).
積血也。从疒於聲。
As per 卒# (compact) + 疒 illness → emaciating illness → *grow thin/lean* (with illness); *be worn out*. Compare 悴.
中寒腫覈。从疒豖聲。
病瘳也。从疒俞聲。
As per 風# (flutter) + 疒 illness → *insanity* (likened to mental fluttering) → *headache*.
楚人謂藥毒曰痛瘌。从疒剌聲。
昜# rise + 疒 illness → *boil*, *carbuncle* or sore rising on the skin. Compare 疔.
頭創也。从疒昜聲。
As per 者# (pile) + 疒 illness → *illness* accompanied by swelling or boils (compare 瘡, 疽 and 疵).
病也。从疒者聲。《詩》曰：“我馬瘏矣。”
女病也。从疒叚聲。
As per 音# (indistinct sound) + 疒 illness → illness rendering one unable to produce distinct words (compare 喑) → *dumb*; *mute*; *unable/unwilling to speak*.
不能言也。从疒音聲。
屰气也。从疒从屰从欠。
小兒瘛瘲病也。从疒恝聲。
寄肉也。从疒息聲。
幽薶也。从土㾜聲。
As per 𥁕# as described in 温 (hold in heat/warmth) + 疒 illness → *contagious disease* characterized by fever. The idea is of heat held down in the body.
As per 脊# (jagged backbone) + 疒 illness → *emaciated* (to the point that one's backbone shows); *grow thin*; *slender*. *Barren soil* is a borrowed meaning via 塉.
As per 倉# (pile) + 疒 illness → *swelling*, *tumor*, *boil* or *scab* piled on the skin. Compare 疽 and 疵.
As per 般# (spread out) + 疒 illness → *scar* that spreads over the skin. Compare 疤.
痍也。从疒般聲。
病也。从疒鬼聲。《詩》曰：“譬彼瘣木。”一曰腫㫄出也。
As per 留# (round) + 疒 illness → a roundish *bump*, *swelling* or *tumor*. Also, a *nuisance*, particularly with reference to a child. Compare 疣.
差# difference + 疒 illness → *illness the symptoms of which take a (slight) turn for the better*. *Epidemic* is a borrowed meaning.
瘉也。从疒𢀩聲。
As per 虐# (be attacked) + 疒 illness → *malaria*. Also, *intermittent fever* (← cyclical symptoms experienced by malaria sufferers). Compare 痎.
熱寒休作。从疒从虐，虐亦聲。
病也。从疒眞聲。一曰腹張。
As per 票# (rise) + 疒 illness → *pus*; *boil*; *carbuncle* (← growths that rise from the skin; compare 疱 and 皰).
靜也。从心㾜聲。
病也。从疒從聲。
As per 翏# (separate from a main unit) + 疒 illness → *heal* by separating an illness from the body → *treat an illness*.
疾瘉也。从疒翏聲。
As per 章# (rise) + 疒 illness → rising *noxious/pestilential vapors*.
病也。从疒祭聲。
As per 婁# (continuum) + 疒 illness → *fistula* (← abnormal passage functioning as a continuum between two body parts ) → *ulceration*. *Hunchback* is a borrowed meaning; compare 僂.
頸腫也。从疒婁聲。
病也。从疒莫聲。
病也。从疒堇聲。
As per 尞# as described in 僚 (circular continuum) + 疒 illness → continuous *treatment* of an illness → *healing*.
As per 隆# (wind upward) + 疒 illness → *tumor* rising on the surface of the skin (compare 瘤). Also, *fatigue* and *retention of urine* (← symptoms of a tumor-accompanied disease).
罷病也。从疒隆聲。
腫也。从疒畱聲。
As per 勞# (stoop) + 疒 illness → stoop with *exhaustion*. Though "tuberculosis" is sometimes noted as a meaning of this character, the sense actually pertains to the compound 癆痎.
朝鮮謂藥毒曰癆。从疒勞聲。
閒# gap + 疒 illness → *spasms*; *convulsions*; *fit* (← medical conditions that occur at gaps/intervals; compare 痃) → *irritability*; *hot temper*.
Abbreviated form# of 廢 die out + 疒 illness → *become ill*; *one who has damaged his/her body*; *chronic illness*. Also, *damage*.
固病也。从疒發聲。

As per 單# (fanning motion) + 疒 illness → unsteady steps (in the manner of the fanning motion of a flat rattan weapon; compare 騨) of one *wasted by illness* (← wasted ← flat/flattened) → *devitalized*.
勞病也。从疒單聲。
As per 嵒# (large, embedded rocks) + 疒 illness → rock-like, cancerous tumor → *cancer*.
病也。从疒閒聲。
痛也。从疒䢉聲。
愈# heal + 疒 illness (for emphasis/clarification) → *healing*; *cure*.
As per 辟# (spread) + 疒 illness → a (bodily) swelling → *peculiarity* (← peculiar condition) → *(bad) habit*; *tendency* → *curl/kink* (in the hair).
As per 厲# (rough) + 疒 illness → *leprosy/Hansen's disease* (condition that roughens the skin and reduces sensation in the extremities of the limbs; compare 癩); *contagious disease*.
惡疾也。从疒，蠆省聲。

鼠# rat/mouse + 疒 illness → *phobia*; *morbid fear* (← rat-inspired dread). In Japan, and on account of its constituent elements, the character has also been specifically applied to plague/Black Death, a rat-borne disease.
寒也。从仌廩聲。
Abbreviated form# of 澱 (sediment) + 疒 illness → *skin disease*; *erythema* (← skin condition characterized by discoloration).
As per 疑# (come to a stop) + 疒 illness → condition in which the thinking process is paralyzed, a condition likened to stupidity → *foolish*.
不慧也。从疒疑聲。
As per 養# (abundant) + 疒 illness → *itchy* skin condition caused by an overly rich diet.
Variant of 節# knot + 疒 illness → *pimple*; *boil* (knotty objects on the skin).
霍# suddenly + 疒 illness → *illness* that strikes suddenly.
As per 賴# (sharp reduction) + 疒 illness → *leprosy/Hansen's disease* (← condition that roughens the skin and reduces sensation in the extremities of the limbs; compare 癘).
積 pile up + 疒 illness → *spasms* (← symptom that appears as a succession of painful sensations) → *irritability*; *anger*.
As per 鮮# (vivid) + 疒 illness → *ringworm* (of vivid color).
乾瘍也。从疒鮮聲。
嬰# extend about + 疒 illness → *swelling* extending about the neck.
頸癅也。从疒嬰聲。
隱# conceal + 疒 illness → concealed illness in the form of a *craving*, (bad) *habit* or *addiction*.
As per 瞿# (look nervously about) + 疒 illness → *emaciated* or *worn out* (on account of nervous exhaustion).
雝# as described in 擁 (contain) + 疒 illness → *carbuncle*/*boil* containing pus.
腫也。从疒雝聲。
顚# topple + 疒 illness → topple/fall down in convulsions → *insanity*; *madness*.
A depiction showing a person's feet split to right and left, reducing mobility → *spread open*.
足剌癶也。从止、𣥂。凡癶之屬皆从癶。讀若撥。
A depiction of an implement with multiple aligned handles that was manipulated by being rotated . *10th calendar sign* is a borrowed meaning.
冬時，水土平，可揆度也。象水從四方流入地中之形。癸承壬，象人足。凡癸之屬皆从癸。
以足蹋夷艸。从癶从殳。《春秋傳》曰：“癹夷蘊崇之。”

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 豆 food stand + an element# combining 廾 pair of hands + 癶 spread feet → ascent, likened to the raising of a food stand → *rise*; *ascend*; *climb* → *ride*; *promote*. 廾 eventually dropped.
上車也。从癶、豆。象登車形。

The element# combining 癶 (split to right and left) + 殳 action indicator means "split to right and left." 發 adds 弓 bow → arrow splitting from a curved bow in being launched → *release* → *start*; *appear/issue suddenly*; *open/emerge all at once*; *spread/extend outward*; *expose* (by digging up); *send* → *counter for bullets/gunshots*.
䠶發也。从弓癹聲。

發.example: 发展 → 發展; 头发 → 頭髮

entries.text: A depiction of an acorn, a large number of which would be scattered over the ground. The meaning *white* is by association with the color of acorn meat. For "large number," compare 百.
西方色也。陰用事，物色白。从入合二。二，陰數。凡白之屬皆从白。
一 (→ a number) + 白# (large number of acorns) → *one hundred* (i.e., a large number).
十十也。从一、𪞶。數，十百爲一貫。相章也。

As per 白# (scatter) + 匕 double-pronged eating implement (→ pitchfork-like implement) → scatter animal feed. Later, 皀 came to refer to the foodstuffs itself and, in Japan, to the *fragrance* given off by *grain*.
穀之馨香也。象嘉穀在裹中之形。匕，所以扱之。或說皀，一粒也。凡皀之屬皆从皀。又讀若香。

Originally 冐# (cover the eyes) + 儿 person → dimly observed human figure. However, 冐 came to written as 白 white (→ pale) and 皃 itself was subsumed in the character 貌, from which it derives the meanings *appearance*; *external aspects*.
頌儀也。从人，白象人面形。凡皃之屬皆从皃。
As per 勺# (rise and become evident) + 白 white (→ color that stands out) → conspicuous *target*; *mark*; *objective* → *obvious*; *hit*; *-like*.
As per 巴# (spread) + 白 white → spreading white object(s) → *spread*.
艸華之白也。从白巴聲。

比# line up + 白. 白 replaces an obsolete element of uncertain signification, and the reason for the selection of 白 is also obscure. *All*, *everyone* and *everything* appear to be connected with the general idea of lining up many people/objects.
俱詞也。从比从𪞶。

As per 王# (extend) + an abbreviated form of 自 (original/originally) → originator of a ruling dynasty, one that extends from earth to heaven → *emperor*. Here, 王 also lends the specific notion "ruler."
大也。从自。自，始也。始皇者，三皇，大君也。自，讀若鼻，今俗以始生子爲鼻子。
A variant form of 敫 as described in 激 (white spray that scatters when waves pound rocks), specifying a high riverbank → *waterside*. 皋 also takes the form 皐 (see 翺).
气皐白之進也。从𠦍从白。《禮》：祝曰臯，登謌曰奏。故臯奏皆从夲。《周禮》曰：“詔來鼓皐舞。”皐，告之也。
月之白也。从白交聲。《詩》曰：“月出皎兮。”

晧 is per 告# (bend) + 日 sun/day → *bright* sunshine, causing plants to bend/wilt (compare 浩). Later, the meaning *white* came to predominate over bright (compare 皋), leading 晧 to be supplanted by 皓, in which 日 is replaced by 白 white.
百# one hundred (doubled) → *two hundred*; *many*; *great* (number/amount of).
二百也。凡皕之屬皆从皕。讀若祕。
析# divide + 白 white → *white* (← hue against which colors are distinctly divided).
人色白也。从白析聲。
豈 here an abbreviated form# of 塏 highland + 白 white → the bleached, *white* landscape of dry highlands (compare 皜).
霜雪之白也。从白豈聲。
顯也。从三白。讀若皎。
As per 高# high/tall (specifically, bleached highlands; compare 皓) + 白 white (for emphasis/clarification) → *pure white* (especially with regard to places/objects that are dry).
日之白也。从白堯聲。
艸木白華也。从華从白。
As per 番# (spread) + 白 white → white/gray hair spreading over the head of an elderly person → *white*.
老人白也。从白番聲。《易》曰：“賁如皤如。”
As per 敫# as described in 激 (white spray) + 白 white → *bright white*; *brilliant* → *clear*.
玉石之白也。从白敫聲。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form combines a drooping pelt with the head still attached + 又 hand/action indicator → spread open (open up) a pelt, then align it over one's body (compare 求, 㒼 as described in 滿 and 表, as well as 韋) → *skin*; *hide*; *leather* → (tree) *bark*; *rind*.
剥取獸革者謂之皮。从又，爲省聲。凡皮之屬皆从皮。
面黑气也。从皮干聲。
包# envelop + 皮 skin/hide → *pimple* (← protrusion enveloped by skin) → (water) *blister*. Compare 疱.
面生气也。从皮包聲。
皮細起也。从皮夋聲。
As per 軍# (circularity) + 皮 skin/hide → round *chaps* on the skin (compare 菌); *rough/cracked skin*.
足坼也。从皮軍聲。
As per 芻# (compress) + 皮 skin/hide → *wrinkle* (← compressed skin) → *crease*.
A depiction of a large *dish*, *plate* or *bowl* covered by a lid that conceals the food beneath it.
飯食之用器也。象形。與豆同意。凡皿之屬皆从皿。讀若猛。
As per 于# (U-shaped) + 皿 dish/plate/bowl → *basin*; *bowl*.
飯器也。从皿亏聲。
As per 不# (bulge) + 皿 dish/plate/bowl → bulging bowl → *cup*; *glass*. 盃 is effectively a variant form of 杯.
器也。从皿弔聲。
中# center/middle + 皿 dish/plate/bowl → small vessel used by being cupped in the center of one's palm → *empty dish/plate/bowl* → *empty sensation*.
器虛也。从皿中聲。《老子》曰：“道盅而用之。”
分# portion + 皿 dish/plate/bowl → apportion food in a wide-mouthed basin/bowl (compare 盤). *Buddhist festival of the dead* is via a transliteration of the Sanskrit ullambana.
盎也。从皿分聲。
覆也。从血、大。
A variant form of 乃 (soft and clingy) + 皿# dish/plate/bowl → *fill* a dish with (soft) food → *be/become full*; *satisfy*.
滿器也。从皿、夃。
調味也。从皿禾聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is 皿 dish/plate/bowl + the character 水 (water) turned on its side, indicating liquid filling a container → *fill* → *advantageous*; *benefit* (← possess full resources) → *profit* (← employ one's advantages to gaining profit). Note a variant form 益.
饒也。从水、皿。皿，益之意也。
盋器。盂屬。从皿犮聲。或从金从本。
小盂也。从皿夗聲。

Originally, the element at top# was not 去 but rather that described in 抑 (now written as 卬, but originally 印 in reverse → hold down). The addition of 皿 dish/plate/bowl suggests the idea of pressing a *cover* down upon a container → *meet* (← meeting of cover and container). *Why* is a borrowed meaning.
As per 央# (stretch) + 皿 dish/plate/bowl → small-mouthed, wide-bellied *pot* → *abundant* (← abundant capacity) → *overflowing*.
盆也。从皿央聲。
As per 合# (press/fit together) + 皿 dish/plate/bowl → *lidded utensil*.
灰# ash + 皿 dish/plate/bowl → *pot* for carrying away ashes → *bowl*; *helmet* (← shape association).

成# make + 皿 dish/plate/bowl → make a heaping dish of food → *heap/pile* (food on a dish) → *serve* (food); *fill* (a bowl); *stack*; *generous serving of* → *prosper*; *flourish*; *succeed*; *do well* → *peak*; (full) *bloom*; *prime*; *be at the height of* → *enthusiastic*; *energetic*; (of animals) *in heat*; *rut*. Also, *popular*, *to a great degree* and *good measure of*.
黍稷在器中以祀者也。从皿成聲。

The top element# is 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure + 水 water → drool with desire for tasty food. 盜 adds 皿 dish/plate/bowl (for emphasis/clarification) → drool with desire for tasty food and take a portion → *steal* → *rob*.
私利物也。从㳄，㳄欲皿者。
As per 戔# (fine/slight) + 皿 dish/plate/bowl → small *cup* (for drinking alcohol) that holds only a slight volume of liquid.

As per 明# (manifest the hidden) + 皿 dish/plate/bowl → drink blood from a bowl in making a *vow/oath*, causing the gods to manifest themselves → *alliance* (← allied forces keeping the vow they have made).

皿 dish/plate/bowl + an element# representing liquid dripping from a brush → ink dripping from a brush into a bowl → *use up*; *exhaust*; *run out of* (← use up the last of one's ink) → *give one's utmost*; *devote oneself to*; *be an extreme of*.
器中空也。从皿㶳聲。

entries.text: The relevant seal inscription form is 臥 lie face down + an element# combining 皿 dish/plate/bowl and a line above it indicating water → lie face down and observe the reflection of one's face in water contained in a bowl/container → *keep watch over*; *supervise*. Compare 督 and 臨.
臨下也。从臥，䘓省聲。
般# tray + 皿 dish/plate/bowl (for emphasis/clarification) → *tray* → *basin*; (game)*board*.
澡手也。从𦥑水臨皿。《春秋傳》曰：“奉𠤷沃盥。”
As per 酓# (contain alcohol) + 皿 dish/plate/bowl → *lidded vessel*; *lid*. Also, *hermitage* (← roofed/lidded hut; compare 庵).
覆蓋也。从皿酓聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is 虍 tiger# (here suggesting a tiger-stripe pattern; compare 彪) + an element combining a container and 皿 dish/plate/bowl → cooking pot with a tiger-stripe pattern, half-sunken into the earth. *Hut/cottage* is a borrowed meaning via 廬.
飯器也。从皿𧇄聲。
㯯盨，負戴器也。从皿須聲。
引擊也。从㚔、攴，見血也。扶風有盩厔縣。
As per 湯# (vapor rising from boiling water) + 皿 dish/plate/bowl → *wash/sweep away* with boiling water. *Waver* and *cause a person to waver/give in* are borrowed meanings, via 蕩.
滌器也。从皿湯聲。

盪.explanation: Sway, wash, oscillate or move back and forth in some words.

entries.text: 古# hard; dried out + an abbreviated form of 鹽 salt → *rock salt* → *land or waters from which salt is extracted*. Also, *brittle* (← crumbly piece of salt).
河東鹽池。袤五十一里，廣七里，周百十六里。从鹽省，古聲。
弻戾也。从弦省，从盩。讀若戾。
A depiction of an *eye*, originally one covered by a curving eyelid directly above it → *look*; *mark* → *point*; *classification*; *ordinal ending*.
人眼。象形。重童子也。凡目之屬皆从目。
目多白也。一曰張目也。从目干聲。
As per 于# (U-shaped) + 目 eye → widen (= make round) the eyes → *watch/observe carefully* (compare 闚) → *be anxious about* (← pay close attention to a worrisome situation).
張目也。从目于聲。一曰朝鮮謂盧童子曰盱。
As per 亡# (obscure) + 目 eye → obscure vision → *blind*.
目無牟子。从目亡聲。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 目 eye + an element# combining a straight line and a dot representing a pupil → eye looking straight ahead → *direct*; *immediately*; *frankness* → *fix/repair*; *correct*; *make/get well* (← straighten out).
正見也。从𠃊从十从目。

目 here an abbreviated form# of 省 (observe) + 木 tree/wood → eyes focused on an object (establishing a *mutual* relation between observer and observed) → *together*; *watch*; *assist*; *assistant*; *shape*; *appearance* → (grammatical) *voice*; *emphatic verbal prefix*. Also, *minister* (← one who assists a ruler).
省視也。从目从木。《易》曰：“地可觀者，莫可觀於木。”《詩》曰：“相鼠有皮。”
恨視也。从目兮聲。
As per 分# (split) + 目 eye → vision (actually/figuratively) split off to the distance → *look*; *clear eyes*.
《詩》曰：“美目盼兮。”从目分聲。
The relevant seal inscription form is 目 eye + a curved visor# → curved *shield* (for the eyes/body) behind which one immediately follows.
瞂也。所以扞身蔽目。象形。凡盾之屬皆从盾。
